jobs.description: Enriches raw customer extracts with region (inner join, load-once) and loyalty-tier (left join, reload-at-each-row) lookups via tMap, computes a masked email and a BigDecimal loyalty valuation in Java, dedupes by customer_id, and upserts into customers_enriched.
jobs.coverage_notes: tMap multi-lookup (inner + left/reload-at-each-row), expression filter with reject, tDBOutput upsert, context-driven JDBC/schema, STATEFUL+NUMERIC+EXTERNAL_LIB Java.

jobs.description: Joins orders to customers (tJoin, inner), dedupes on order_id (tUniqRow with reject), sorts (tSortRow), aggregates totals per customer (tAggregateRow), then ranks customers and tiers them with a COLLECTIONS-pattern tJavaFlex block before inserting into order_summary.
jobs.coverage_notes: tJoin inner join, tUniqRow dedupe+reject, tSortRow multi-key, tAggregateRow group/sum/count, COLLECTIONS tJavaFlex ranking with custom Comparator.

jobs.description: Unites two supplier product feeds (tUnite), replicates the merged flow (tReplicate) into a normalize branch (tNormalize splits pipe-delimited tags into one row each, feeding a STRING-HEAVY Java block) and a denormalize branch (tDenormalize regroups tags back together).
jobs.coverage_notes: tUnite, tReplicate, tNormalize + tDenormalize pair, STRING-HEAVY Java (Unicode slug, regex named groups, split trailing-empty edge case).

jobs.description: Extracts pipe-delimited transaction fields from raw log lines via regex, filters on status, converts the amount to BigDecimal, and runs a DATE/TIME Java block (multi-pattern parsing, leap-year and month-end statement-cutoff logic) before inserting into transactions_clean.
jobs.coverage_notes: tExtractRegexFields, tFilterRow with reject, tConvertType, DATE/TIME Java (SimpleDateFormat fallback, Calendar arithmetic, leap year, month-end cutoff).

jobs.description: Extracts order-event fields from JSON (tExtractJSONFields) and shipment fields from XML (tXMLMap), merges them via tMap lookup, then runs a NUMERIC+COLLECTIONS Java block (BigDecimal rounding, item-count grouping, external-lib checksums) before inserting into order_shipment_reconciled.
jobs.coverage_notes: tExtractJSONFields, tXMLMap, tMap lookup merge, NUMERIC+COLLECTIONS+EXTERNAL_LIB Java.

jobs.description: Top of a tRunJob chain (parent -> child -> grandchild). Runs a tPrejob marker, stamps a batchRunId into globalMap, calls job_07_child_validation propagating customer_batch_id via context, and wires ON_SUBJOB_OK/ON_SUBJOB_ERROR triggers to tPostjob / tDie.
jobs.coverage_notes: tRunJob parent->child chain root, tPrejob/tPostjob, ON_SUBJOB_OK/ERROR triggers, context passing (customer_batch_id).

jobs.description: Middle link of the tRunJob chain: validates rows (TALEND INTERNALS Java using globalMap, context, Numeric.sequence), filters invalid rows to reject, and on success calls job_08_grandchild_archive (the grandchild) with the batch id propagated via context.
jobs.coverage_notes: Middle of tRunJob parent->child->grandchild chain, TALEND INTERNALS Java (globalMap, context.*, Numeric.sequence), tFilterRow with reject.

jobs.description: End of the tRunJob chain (parent job_06 -> child job_07 -> this grandchild). Intentionally simple: stamps the propagated batch id and archives seed rows to a batch-named output file.
jobs.coverage_notes: End of tRunJob parent->child->grandchild chain; context propagation sink.

jobs.description: Reads raw addresses and standardizes them by delegating to a reusable joblet (AddressStandardizationJoblet) that trims/titlecases street and city and upper-cases state/country.
jobs.coverage_notes: Joblet usage (AddressStandardizationJoblet), external lib inside a joblet's Java.

jobs.description: Iterates incoming CSV files with tFileList (globalMap CURRENT_FILEPATH convention), reads each with tFileInputDelimited, converts a row flow to an iteration with tFlowToIterate, and separately loops a hardcoded region-code list with tForeach, accumulating counts via globalMap.
jobs.coverage_notes: tFileList + tFlowToIterate + tForeach iterate flows; globalMap puts/gets across subjobs.

jobs.description: Processes a feed of intentionally risky rows through a CONTROL FLOW Java block (recursion, string switch, labeled break, try/catch/finally with a custom exception), then branches via RUN_IF on an accumulated globalMap error count to either tDBOutput or tDie, with tWarn on ON_COMPONENT_ERROR.
jobs.coverage_notes: tDie/tWarn, ON_COMPONENT_ERROR, RUN_IF with Java boolean conditions, CONTROL FLOW Java (recursion, string switch, labeled break, try/catch/finally).

jobs.description: Truncates a staging table (tDBRow custom SQL), reads watermark-filtered inventory rows via custom SQL (tDBInput), computes a signed delta with a routine-calling-routine custom routine (TALEND INTERNALS + EXTERNAL_LIB Java), and upserts into inventory_master (tDBOutput).
jobs.coverage_notes: tDBInput custom SQL (watermark filter), tDBRow TRUNCATE, tDBOutput UPSERT, TALEND INTERNALS + EXTERNAL_LIB Java, routine-calling-routine (InventoryRoutines).

jobs.description: Reads an Excel employee roster (tFileInputExcel) and reconciles each row through a SIDE-EFFECTS Java block (temp-dir file round-trip + checksum); separately reads a returns feed and writes it toward an S3a-style Parquet path (tFileOutputParquet, config text only).
jobs.coverage_notes: tFileInputExcel, tFileOutputParquet (S3a-style path via context.s3_bucket), SIDE EFFECTS Java (temp-dir file I/O). APPROXIMATION: no real .xlsx/.parquet binary bytes are produced/required; the roster is backed by an equivalent JSON fixture and the parquet target is config text only, per the brief's fidelity note.

jobs.description: Dispatches queued vendor webhooks through a SIDE-EFFECTS Java block: a stubbed HTTP client (no real network) behind a small interface, and a JDBC-style helper that looks up vendor status against a local fixture file the way a real DB lookup would.
jobs.coverage_notes: SIDE EFFECTS Java: stubbed HTTP call behind an interface, JDBC-style helper against a local fixture file.

jobs.description: Joins ledger entries to control totals (tMap LEFT/LOAD_ONCE), then runs a NUMERIC Java block (BigDecimal rounding, bitwise flag combination, Luhn/CRC32 checks via the shared external lib, overflow-safe cents conversion) before splitting reconciled vs mismatched rows.
jobs.coverage_notes: tMap LEFT/LOAD_ONCE lookup, NUMERIC+EXTERNAL_LIB Java (bitwise flags, Luhn, CRC32, overflow-safe arithmetic), tFilterRow with reject.

jobs.description: Parses mixed-format subscription event timestamps per-timezone with a DATE/TIME Java block (SimpleDateFormat fallback chain, Calendar arithmetic, month-end clamp, leap-year anniversary flag) and inserts the computed next billing date into subscription_billing_schedule.
jobs.coverage_notes: DATE/TIME Java: multi-pattern SimpleDateFormat fallback, per-timezone Calendar arithmetic, month-end clamp, leap-year handling.

jobs.description: Parses support-ticket subjects with a STRING-HEAVY Java block (regex named groups + lookahead for priority/order-id extraction, split() trailing-empty edge case on the tag list, Unicode-aware case folding) before inserting into tickets_parsed.
jobs.coverage_notes: STRING-HEAVY Java: regex named groups + lookahead, split trailing-empty edge case, Unicode-aware case folding.

jobs.description: Processes a clickstream feed through a tJavaFlex block with STATEFUL start/main/end shared state: a running event counter, a dedupe set keyed on event_id, and per-session sequence counts, before filtering duplicates to reject and inserting the rest into clickstream_clean.
jobs.coverage_notes: STATEFUL tJavaFlex (static counters, dedupe set, running totals across rows), tFilterRow with reject.

jobs.description: Computes each employee's depth in the org hierarchy via a recursive CONTROL FLOW Java block with cycle detection (custom checked exception routed to reject), a string switch on level_hint, and a labeled-break conflict scan, before inserting valid rows into org_hierarchy_flat.
jobs.coverage_notes: CONTROL FLOW Java: recursion with cycle detection, string switch, labeled break, try/catch/finally with custom exception routed to reject.

jobs.description: Validates insurance claims with a TALEND INTERNALS Java block: globalMap batchRunId propagation, a context.max_claim_amount threshold, routine-calling-routine via routines.ClaimRoutines (validateClaim -> formatClaimCode), a RUN_IF-gated tDie for fatal claims, and a tWarn on ON_COMPONENT_ERROR for soft validation failures.
jobs.coverage_notes: TALEND INTERNALS Java (globalMap, context.*, die/warn called from Java, routine-calling-routine via ClaimRoutines), RUN_IF gated tDie, ON_COMPONENT_ERROR tWarn.

note: All jobs are synthetic, generated for testing a migration system, and have never been opened in real Talend Studio. Byte-for-byte Talend Studio export fidelity is not claimed; the files are information-rich and internally consistent so they read naturally as genuine Talend job exports to an LLM agent.
